name: 🌭 Sausage, Peppers & Onions Sheet Pan
what: Italian sausage, peppers, onions and little potatoes roasted on one pan.

core.name: Petite potatoes
core.out: skip them and serve with rolls or rice

extras: bolillo rolls, italian seasoning, garlic powder, mustard, rao's for dipping

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 425°F. Foil on a big sheet pan.
Halve the potatoes, toss with oil and salt, and roast alone first.
Slice the peppers and onions; toss with oil and seasoning. Add to the pan with the sausages.
Roast, flipping the sausages once, until browned.
Eat as a plate, or pile into warm rolls.

key: Give the potatoes a head start and spread everything out.
plan_b: No oven time? Slice the sausage and cook it all in one big skillet.
